I. Background and General Information 
 
The site consists of a 50-acre parcel currently owned by Billy Williams. The 
parcel is identified as Columbia County Parcel # 043 130. Impact Community Church 
wishes to purchase and subdivide the lot to facilitate development of a new church 
location. The church proposes subdividing the existing parcel into 5 parcels of 12.17, 
8.78, 3.00, 4.22, and 21.78 acres (see site map below). The development plan for the 
church includes building a main church building with associated parking and utilities.

Gordon Hwy. The church wishes to rezone Lot A from R-A to S-1 to accommodate 
this development. The remaining parcels will remain R-A and will share a common 
drive with the church. The R-A zoned lots will be developed for residential use at a 
future date.
